label: Wat Ratanaram (Wat Ton Kaeo)

scripts.label: Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา

lede: Wat Ratanaram (Wat Ton Kaeo) accounts for 4 catalogued manuscripts. It clusters in Chiang Mai (100% of the corpus for this temple). Nearly all (100%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. Dated witnesses run 1873–1874 CE (4 of 4 carry a date).
